name: Texto del dueño sobre un video

video_text.overlay_revision_doc: Bump with ANY change to src/templates/video_text/* that can move a pixel of the overlay. The layer_still engine it reuses (engine.ts, LayerStill.tsx's Scrim and TextBlocks, the font loading) is pinned by layer_still's own layer_catalog.engine_revision, echoed as report.engine_revision; Python puts BOTH in the job id.
video_text.source: ED-13 (m-25029108): v1's text block (EF-05) on four closed backgrounds — scrim, band, brand_fill, shadow (clean white letters, no text shadow) —, band and brand_fill in the colour the owner picked (texts.box_color, #RRGGBB, letters white or #111111 by contrast) and, for «Letra por letra», the backdrop and the letters as separate ports with every character's box in the letters' report
